title: Fermatas on bars, rests and stems
description: Every place a fermata can sit, drawn once each: over a stem-down note beside its accent (the fermata is the outermost sign), over a rest (angled, short), over a stem-up half note clearing the stem tip (square, long); then the bar form over the closing barline of each measure — the plain sign on bar 1, a square sign under bar 2's final barline. Bar 2 shows the below side on a note (orient below) and a down-pointing curlew on a rest, which reads as the below form when no side is given. Not on tab: the bar form draws under the tab staff too, the event form stays notation-only like the articulations (core-measure-attributes-gaps.md, item 8).
